outreach_subject: Crew houses near Cannington for the A39 resurfacing
outreach_body:
Hi {first_name},

Congratulations on winning the A39 Bridgwater to Cannington resurfacing and drainage contract. If you have crews travelling to Cannington, we have 2 whole houses within 25 miles of the site, the nearest just 0.8 miles away, from £29.50 per person per night with bills included.

Whole houses keep a crew together, with Wi-Fi, council tax and cleaning covered, and van parking available. We quote the same day.

Reply to this email or call 0800 088 4225.

Reply 'no thanks' and we won't contact you again
linkedin_message: Congratulations on the A39 Bridgwater to Cannington contract. We have whole houses for crews near Cannington, bills included, from £29.50 pppn. Happy to send a same-day quote if you have people travelling.
call_script: Congratulate them on the A39 Bridgwater to Cannington award.
Ask when crews mobilise and how many will travel.
Explain we have 2 houses within 25 miles, nearest 0.8 miles from site.
Bills, Wi-Fi, council tax and cleaning included; weekly or monthly terms.
Offer a same-day quote and confirm the best email.
